scores.evidence: Each phase below depends on the ones before it
scores.rationale: Mostly sensible order (CRDT core, persistence, then features), but auth/permissions come after sharing and persistence, and the single-user editor is built before the merge model is proven.

scores.evidence: Phase 1: Single-user editor ... one person can create, edit and save a document.
scores.rationale: Phase 0 is only decisions; the first milestone is a local single-user editor with no deployed end-to-end production path.

scores.evidence: CRDT (Yjs or Automerge): Recommended. ... OT ... Needs a central server.
scores.rationale: Irreversible decisions (CRDT vs OT, doc model, targets) are listed up front with a default for one, but there are no explicit flip conditions, and the doc model and targets have no defaults.

scores.evidence: This is the riskiest part of the project, so test it early.
scores.rationale: Shared core and conflict tests precede leaf features, but auth and permissions (wide impact) are placed after presence, and ordering within phases isn't justified by blast radius.

scores.evidence: Security review covering XSS in rich text, permission bypass over the socket connection and data isolation
scores.rationale: Security is mostly a trailing review in Phase 8, and auth is Phase 5. Phases 1–4 have none.

scores.evidence: Monitoring: sync delay, connection counts and alerts if copies of a document drift apart.
scores.rationale: Observability appears only in Phase 7, not from Phase 0.
There is no mention of reproducible builds, environments, CI, or infrastructure as code in any phase.

scores.evidence: the server restarts while people are editing, and nothing is lost.
scores.rationale: Resilience appears in Phase 3 (reconnect, offline, restart) and Phase 7 (limits, compaction), but not in the early phases or every phase.
The plan never addresses whether an AI layer applies, so there is no N/A declaration.

scores.evidence: Suggestion mode (tracked changes), if you need it.
scores.rationale: Some items are marked optional and a demo shortcut is given, but there is no explicit deferred list with pull-forward conditions.

note: A readable, sensibly ordered feature sequence, but it has no production walking skeleton. Security, observability and reproducibility are not threaded through the phases, and the AI-layer question is never addressed.
